reference: DATA-INTEGRITY benchmark, not a physics one: this tool computes nothing, it compares industries over a catalogue of attention points, counter-measures, conflicts between measures and key figures traced to worked material. The reference is an independent python re-implementation (bench-src/ref/gen_procesklimaat.py) of the record schema, the referential closure, the per-industry selection semantics, the category filter and the conflict engine, written from the documented meaning of the tables rather than from the page's own functions.
reference_citations: Independent re-implementation of the schema, referential closure, selection, filter and conflict semantics: bench-src/ref/gen_procesklimaat.py (this repository).

The key figures are traced by the data itself to the worked material of this collection (file and line); the benchmark verifies that every cited file is in the shipped source-file index and that every cited line lies inside the recorded length of that file.
tolerance: Exact set equality, with no tolerance at all. Every industry, filter, comparator pair and conflict path must produce exactly the set of record ids computed independently in python; every printed count and live tile must equal a recount; schema, referential-closure and six-language checks must report zero errors. The preset invariant is absolute: a starting set offered to a user must raise no hard conflict and no warning under the independently recomputed verdict.
crosscheck: The page ships its own structural-check panel. It is deliberately not used as a reference: a self-check that re-evaluates the page's own tables does not validate them.
not_benchmarked: whether an attention point, a counter-measure or a conflict is good engineering advice — that is a judgement, not a fact this harness can check

the numerical correctness of the key figures themselves: they are quoted from worked examples of the collection with the conditions they were obtained under, and the benchmark checks the provenance chain (file, line, conditions, layer) rather than re-deriving the physics

cases.note: The page comes up with every industry, the attention points of the first one, the six live tiles and the category filter row
notes: tile labels read from the page: ["POINTS COVERED","STILL OPEN","HARD CONFLICTS","WARNINGS","PAIRING HINTS","MEASURES TICKED"] (the six tilesData() declares, upper-cased by the page stylesheet)

cases.note: Every attention point, measure, conflict rule, industry and key figure validates against the schema the page expects, including the layer rule that an entry standing for a sold or open-law instrument reproduces no value and no trace from the instrument itself

No measure, rule, industry or key figure points at a record that does not exist, every key figure is traced to a file that is in the source index, and every cited line number lies inside the length of that file
notes: 75 of 79 indexed source files are not cited by any key figure — the index covers the whole worked material, not only what this page quotes, so this is recorded and not graded

cases.note: Each of the 24 industries offers exactly the attention points its record names and exactly the measures that answer them minus the ones excluded for that industry, grouped into the right groups, and each category filter count equals a recount
The category filter keeps exactly those attention points whose own category matches or which carry a matching measure, for every category and for the reset case, across eight industries

Every conflict path driven through the checkboxes (174 reachable cases out of 176: each rule's two measures together, each rule's first measure alone, and every industry with all of its measures selected at once) raises exactly the hard conflicts, warnings and pairing hints recomputed in python, and the live tiles agree with them

The typical starting set the page offers for each industry contains only measures that industry carries and raises no hard conflict and no warning under an independently recomputed verdict — that is the invariant the preset exists to guarantee

The industry comparator's only-A, only-B and shared sets are exactly the set difference and intersection of the two industries' attention points, over 26 pairs including an industry compared with itself (where only-A and only-B are empty)
Every one of the 871 catalogue strings carries all six languages with no empty value and no placeholder, and the page really switches into each of them
An industry, a comparison partner, a category filter and a measure selection survive encode -> link -> fresh load
